functions.name: next_prime_gap
functions.cap: smallest prime > n minus n; n >= 1

functions.name: prime_pi
functions.cap: count of primes <= x (sieve; x <= ~1e7 practical)

functions.name: goldbach_count
functions.cap: unordered prime pairs summing to even n

functions.name: goldbach_even
functions.cap: 1 iff even n >= 4 has a prime decomposition (USE THIS, not 2*m mappings)

functions.name: legendre_gap
functions.cap: primes strictly between n^2 and (n+1)^2 (USE THIS for Legendre)

functions.name: rad
functions.cap: product of distinct prime factors; n <= ~1e12 practical

functions.name: abc_quality_gt
functions.cap: EXACT quality comparison q(a+b=c) > p/q via integer powers (no floats); requires coprime a+b=c

functions.name: waring_min_s
functions.cap: minimal s: n is a sum of s k-th powers; k <= 4, n <= 20000

functions.name: primorial
functions.cap: product of first n primes; n <= 5000

functions.name: gilbreath_rows_ok
functions.cap: first k Gilbreath difference rows all start with 1; k <= 5000

modes.name: exhaustive
modes.semantics: COMPLETE cartesian product — proof of the bounded statement; <= 5M cases

modes.name: witness/certificate
modes.usage: certificate-check verifier: {script, witness, expression?, predicate?, allDistinct?, tupleAllPrime?}
modes.semantics: runner decides exit; verify() + exact checks must all pass

notes: Exhaustive cap 5,000,000 cases (maxCases default 3,000,000). Prefer goldbach_even(n)/legendre_gap(n) over 2*m / m*m variable mappings — they keep the verified domain equal to the natural claim variable.
